name: ClearCart text dark-pattern classifier
architecture: Soft-voting ensemble: TF-IDF (word 1-2g + char 2-5g) + Logistic Regression (weight 0.7) and frozen MiniLM embeddings + surface features + XGBoost (weight 0.3); temperature-scaled (T=0.448); flag if calibrated P(dark) >= 0.68
training_data: yamanalab/ec-darkpattern dataset.tsv - train split only (1645 rows); grouped by page and text template to prevent leakage
limitations: Trained on short English e-commerce strings from 2019 shopping sites; other languages and domains are out of scope.
Obstruction, sneaking and forced-action patterns had too few examples (43 rows total) to be learned as categories.
Scores estimate how closely text matches labelled dark-pattern examples; they cannot verify whether a deadline or stock claim is actually false.
Screenshot support is OCR + text classification; visual layout and styling are not analysed.
Preselected-option findings are rule-based DOM observations, not model predictions.
